name: io.github.llmops-pro/nostr-ops-mcp
description: Nostr identity, publishing, and DMs for agents: query relays, publish notes/long-form/addressable events, NIP-44/04 DMs, NIP-19 encoding, NIP-05 verification — with kind/DM allowlists, rate limiting, and an audit log.

environmentVariables.name: NOSTR_NIP46_URI
environmentVariables.description: NIP-46 bunker URI (preferred signer; keeps the nsec off this machine)

environmentVariables.name: NOSTR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: nsec private key (alternative to NOSTR_NIP46_URI; read-only mode if neither is set)

environmentVariables.name: NOSTR_ALLOWED_KINDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated event kinds the server may publish (required when a signer is configured)
